With this victory, Antonelli becomes the youngest multiple race winner in Formula 1 history and moves into the lead of the drivers’ championship ahead of Russell. [1]

The Mercedes driver leads the 2026 drivers’ championship with 302 points and has won eight of the 15 races run this season. [2]

George Russell closed the gap in the drivers’ championship to 66 points from his Mercedes teammate Kimi Antonelli after taking his third win of the season at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. [3]
